mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_change_token (user_id, new_email, token_hash, expires_at, requested_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{newEmail}, #{tokenHash}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{expiryMinutes} MINUTE), #{requestedIp})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() )

SELECT id, user_id, new_email, token_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, requested_ip, created_at FROM email_change_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.update: UPDATE email_change_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
UPDATE email_change_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM email_change_token WHERE expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP() OR consumed_at IS NOT NULL
